alex: SDK snippet — prefer this minimal Python example for the quickstart section:
```
from redwood import Redwood
import os
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate("Hello world", headers={"X-RW-Burst":"true"})
print(resp.text)
```
maria: can we show curl too for ops folks
alex: sure, curl example here:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-RW-Burst: true" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
sam: small correction: the canonical burst header is X-RW-Burst, but quota-mode header is X-RW-Quota-Mode (values: metered|reserved)
